You're welcome! That extends to other forms like "whomever", e.g. "I'll welcome whomever comes through the door." The other part where people get confused is when they use it as a question. "Who was at the meeting last night?" since it's the subject, but "Whom did you see at the meeting last night?" since it's the object and receives the action of "see". If you're ever confused about it, reword the sentence to where you can replace it with either "he" or "him" and it'll be clear. "Whom did you see?" --> "I saw him." "Who was there?" --> "He was there." Not "I saw he" or "him was there".
